title: SAO Nunchuck - SAO++ edition
credit: Original design: Andy and Jared Geppert (ageppert, Machine Ideas), github.com/ageppert/SAO_Nunchuck, MIT
notes: No switch, no coin cell, no controller: the badge's I2C master talks straight to the Nunchuk at address 0x52.
Badge-driven: the SAO 3.3 V feeds the Nunchuk and both Qwiic sockets directly. Nothing on this board can feed a cell.
J2 is the maker's edge-finger tongue: the Wii Nunchuk cable plug slides onto it. Finger 2 is unused by a Nunchuk.
J3 and J4: Qwiic (JST SH) sockets that pass the same bus on to other I2C boards. Shells to GND.
